title: Child Predator Tries to Meet Up with Minor, Gets Greeted By Police
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On June 2, 2022, a man traveled for two and a half hours, anticipating a meeting with a 15-year-old girl in Cumberland, WI. As he reached the agreed location, several Cumberland Police officers and DCI agents caught him by surprise and quickly apprehended him. Later investigations unveiled that the man worked as a surgical technician, was married, and had two children. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
